policy_sections.title: Policy Overview
policy_sections.content: This policy reimburses eligible medical expenses incurred for covered treatment and services, subject to item-level limits, exclusions, and the applicable co-pay. The policy is intended for routine claim reimbursement where the claimant submits an itemized provider invoice.

policy_sections.title: Claim Context and General Conditions
policy_sections.content: Claims are evaluated against the policy terms in force on the relevant claim date. Reimbursement is based on eligible line items present on the submitted invoice. Amounts that fall outside a covered category or are listed as excluded are not reimbursable. The policy currency is INR.

policy_sections.title: Covered Expenses and Reimbursement Limits
policy_sections.content: The following categories are covered, subject to the stated reimbursement basis and limits. A more specific category rule overrides a broader category rule when both could apply.

policy_sections.title: Excluded Expenses
policy_sections.content: The following items and expense types are excluded and are not reimbursable under this policy, even when they appear on an otherwise valid medical invoice.

policy_sections.title: Reimbursement Calculation Rules
policy_sections.content: For each covered line item, reimbursement equals the lower of the billed amount and the applicable policy limit when a limit exists. Actuals means the billed amount is reimbursable when the category is covered and no other exclusion applies. After item-level reimbursement limits are applied, a 10 percent co-pay is deducted from the total eligible amount. Excluded items contribute zero to the eligible amount.

policy_sections.title: Definitions
policy_sections.content: Per day means the stated maximum applies for each billed day. Per visit means the maximum applies to each consultation or visit. Per session means the limit applies to each physiotherapy session. Per service means the limit applies to each instance of the named service. Per claim means the limit is applied once across that category for the claim. Actuals means the billed line amount is eligible when the category is covered and no exclusion applies.

policy_sections.title: Administrative Information
policy_sections.content: This is a synthetic policy created for the claim adjudication exercise. Administrative details such as policy name, version, currency, and effective period are provided as reference information and do not themselves determine line-item eligibility.

exclusion_rules.conditions: Personal care kits, toiletries, grooming items and similar personal-use products are excluded.
Cosmetic products and cosmetic procedures are excluded.
Wellness, spa and lifestyle improvement programs are excluded.
Health supplements, nutritional supplements and similar non-treatment products are excluded.
Gym, fitness club and membership fees are excluded.
Special diet meals, meal plans and non-medical food charges are excluded.
Television, entertainment and room entertainment charges are excluded.
Telephone and personal communication charges are excluded.
Internet, Wi-Fi and personal connectivity charges are excluded.
Laundry, clothing cleaning and personal housekeeping charges are excluded.
Administrative, processing, file handling and similar non-medical fees are excluded.
Registration, admission processing and similar administrative entry fees are excluded.
Meals or food charges for attendants are excluded.
Convenience goods that are not required for medical treatment are excluded.
Fitness training, personal training and fitness coaching programs are excluded.
Club, service, subscription and other membership fees are excluded.
Beauty, grooming and salon services are excluded.
Elective services primarily intended for lifestyle or appearance rather than medical treatment are excluded.
Chargers, headphones, personal electronics and similar personal goods are excluded.
Other miscellaneous goods or services without a direct medical treatment purpose are excluded.

reimbursement_rules.rule_precedence: A specific named coverage rule overrides a broader generic coverage category when both apply.
reimbursement_rules.line_item_calculation: For a covered line with a limit, eligible amount is the lower of the billed amount and the applicable limit multiplied by the relevant quantity or duration. For actuals, eligible amount equals the billed line amount.
reimbursement_rules.excluded_item_calculation: Excluded items have an eligible amount of zero.

copay.calculation_basis: Total eligible amount after applying item-level coverage limits and exclusions.

reimbursement_rules.final_reimbursement: Total eligible amount minus the applicable 10 percent co-pay.
